name: Shanghai MOONS' Electric Co.,Ltd.
summary: Shanghai MOONS' Electric Co.,Ltd., established in 1994 and headquartered in Shanghai, China, specializes in the development and distribution of motion control, smart lighting, and industrial equipment management solutions. The company serves a global clientele across the Asia Pacific, the Americas, and Europe. Its extensive portfolio of motion control products includes a variety of motors, such as stepper, slotless/coreless, step-servo, servo, and brushless DC motors, along with their respective drivers, integrated motor units, and linear motion systems. Essential accessories like cables, dampers, gearboxes, couplings, brakes, gears, pulleys, and encoders are also supplied. In the intelligent lighting sector, MOONS' primarily offers LED drivers. Furthermore, the company provides condition monitoring equipment, including portable vibration inspectors, analyzers, and wireless supervisory systems, alongside electronic components like connectors/interconnects. An online retail platform complements its sales channels. Shanghai MOONS' Electric Co.,Ltd. operates as a subsidiary of Shanghai Mingzhi Investment Management Co., Ltd.
